subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

Leave now; _________ you'll be late.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The conjunction "**otherwise**" is used to show what the result will be if a particular action is not taken or a condition is not met.
 
• In this context, "**otherwise**" is the most appropriate word to indicate that if you do not leave now, you will be late.
 
• The other options do not fit logically or grammatically into the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Leave now; **otherwise** you'll be late."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Until:** This word is used to indicate the time up to the point that something happens. It does not fit the context here.
 
• **If:** This word introduces a conditional clause. It does not fit the structure of the sentence.
 
• **Unless:** This word means except if. It also does not fit the context and sentence structure here.
